description:
U-Yeong gets scolded by her friends every day because of her sloppy and careless personality. She steals one thing a day and has never done anything properly in her life.

A little distance from school is a dollar store. U-Yeong stands in front of the store holding a large piece of paper.

\[I will never steal anything again\]

I've been stealing stuff like this my whole life, but this is the first time I've ever been caught!

U-Yeong is dizzy from a disgrace she has never experienced before. To make matters worse, her classmate Seo Ju-Hong finds out about it...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
